title: The World's Strongest Rearguard: Labyrinth Country's Novice Seeker

premise: Arihito Atobe, a burned-out office worker, finds himself in a world of monster-filled labyrinths alongside his former workaholic boss, Kyouka Igarashi. He chooses the 'rearguard' class, which supports allies from the back line, and builds a party through teamwork, hiring and freeing companions and helping to lift curses such as Theresia's.
life_message: Supporting others from behind the scenes is real strength, and good teamwork beats lone heroics.
